description: Serves the build (built first unless build:false) inside a local replica of the Gamealia game page (the real portal frame plus mock ads) on 127.0.0.1 and returns the page URL and the bare game URL for the user (or you) to open. No login, nothing is uploaded. It keeps running until stop:true or the MCP server exits; calling it again for the same folder restarts it. For automated checks use gamealia_run_autotest; to play it yourself, gamealia_playtest.

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

stop.description: Stop the preview of this folder instead of starting one

title.description: Title shown on the replica page (default: the build's index.html <title>, else "Preview")

name: gamealia_preview
title: Preview in a portal replica
